result.question: Quantas internacoes ocorreram com estado de residencia diferente do estado do hospital por ano?
result.gold_sql: WITH base AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") AS ano, mr."SG_UF" AS uf_residencia, mh."SG_UF" AS uf_hospital FROM internacoes i LEFT JOIN municipios mr ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mr."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" JOIN hospital h ON i."CNES" = h."CNES" JOIN municipios mh ON h."MUNIC_MOV" = mh."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" WHERE i."DT_INTER" IS NOT NULL AND regexp_full_match(mr."SG_UF", '^[A-Z]{2}$') AND regexp_full_match(mh."SG_UF", '^[A-Z]{2}$')) SELECT ano, COUNT(*) AS internacoes_estado_diferente FROM base WHERE uf_residencia <> uf_hospital GROUP BY ano ORDER BY ano;
result.generated_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") AS ano, COUNT(*) AS total FROM internacoes i JOIN hospital h ON i."CNES" = h."CNES" WHERE i."MUNIC_RES" <> h."MUNIC_MOV" GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") ORDER BY ano;
